name: AgentTrust Gateway
description: Reusable trust and commerce gateway for independently operated AI agents on Concordium. Provides identity verification, capability discovery, agent-to-agent payment, and verifiable activity evidence.

skills.name: Agent Identity Verification
skills.description: Resolve a CIS-8004 agent, confirm its owner and Active status, and verify its Agent Card hash.

skills.name: Capability Discovery
skills.description: Search and filter registered agents by capability, owner, or status via the registry indexer.

skills.name: Agent Payment Settlement
skills.description: Execute and evidence agent-to-agent payments over the x402 protocol on Concordium.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
